head: c5955f3d47ffc8ff21bd59f77ae6846263ced4c6
summary: The exact head passes the UI check, the root check and the selection-preservation proof, and the live main-navigation integration works against real Solr. ./gradlew -p ui check --no-build-cache --rerun-tasks exits 0 with JVM 63 run / 2 skipped / 0 failed and wasm 67 run / 3 skipped / 0 failed; IndexQueryViewModelTest 4/4, HttpIndexQueryRepositoryTest 4/4 and IndexQueryHeaderTest 8/8. Root check -x test exits 0. The adapted regression test fails on the old state holder at 90d4efb ('expected </select> but was <null>') and passes at this head. Live Solr cloud on 8983 exposed books/films/no_select; the UI loaded the collection and handler lists from Solr, preserved /select across films to books, cleared it on no_select (which exposes only /select_hidden), and kept its state through Configsets and back to Index & Query. Two edge cases in the gate list were not exercised live: a response missing required fields, and cancellation of an in-flight handler load.

legs.exact_head_ui_check: passed: ./gradlew -p ui check --no-build-cache --rerun-tasks exit 0, BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 3m40s; JVM 63 run / 2 skipped / 0 failed (18 suites); wasm 67 run / 3 skipped / 0 failed (19 suites); 2026-11-20T16:42Z
legs.fail_before: passed proof: at 90d4efb (state holder before the fix) with only the adapted assertion added, IndexQueryStateHolderTest.testSelectingCollectionPreservesAvailableHandlerAndClearsUnavailableHandler fails: 4 tests completed, 1 failed, AssertionError 'expected:</select> but was:<null>' at line 85; the same assertion passes at this head
legs.root_check: passed: ./gradlew check -x test -Prefguide.include=false exit 0, BUILD SUCCESSFUL in 3m01s
legs.live_ui: passed: packaged Solr 11.0.0-SNAPSHOT on 8983 with collections films, books and no_select (configset with /select renamed /select_hidden); wasm bundle served at /solr/ui/. Collections and handlers loaded from Solr; films + /select selected; books selection preserved /select; no_select cleared it; sidebar Configsets, Configsets tabs (Overview/Files/Schema/Index / Query) and return to Index & Query all navigated and kept the selected item
legs.invalid_collection_path: passed: repository rejects empty, dot, dot-dot, leading dash, slash, query and percent-encoded path segments before any request (0 requests in the unit test); live request for a nonexistent collection returns HTTP 404 with a SolrException body
legs.explicit_empty_fields: passed: no_select returns a requestHandlers map without /select and the UI clears the handler; IndexQueryHeader tests cover empty option lists with the no-collections/no-handlers message
legs.network_failure: partial: HttpIndexQueryRepositoryTest asserts a non-success (503) response becomes Result.failure; no live UI run against an unreachable host

coverage_limits: A response missing required JSON fields was not exercised in the UI; the decoding path is only covered indirectly by the failure tests.
Cancellation of an in-flight handler load (selecting a second collection while the first request is pending) was not exercised on this host.
The wasm UI was run only from the real Solr origin; attempts to serve the bundle from an alternate host for edge-case injection did not get past the app's startup resources on this host.
wasm browser tests ran under Chrome Headless Shell with the software renderer; GL-only rendering is not covered.
Root check excludes Antora/ref-guide per standing policy.
